verdict.rationale: Brevo's MCP evidence (brevo-docs-15, brevo-docs-27) describes Brevo acting as an MCP server, so external AI assistants can operate on a Brevo account. That is the opposite role and does not transfer to this story. Nothing in the pack shows Brevo or its Aura AI connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
